specials.note: all of Logan's 23 hits on the trip were bleeds, a Charge or transfixed copies (docs/NOTES.md). Bleeds: 8-10 every 3 s, 5 ticks over 15 s, then 'You are no longer bleeding.' (3 bleeds, capture). Bound soul: 'They begin to draw blood from you!' with an opener of -23/-32 on Logan a tile off while it meleed the gravebug, 2 in its 19 swings at a pet with Logan within 1 tile [INFERENCE: an area bleed on everyone within 1]. Vampire bat: 'The creature strikes ferociously, causing you to bleed!' on its target, 15 % (follower Bleed, knowledge #14664). Nightstalker Charge: teleports up to 12 tiles, hits up to 3 within 1 tile (knowledge #14625); live '*charges*' at 21:21:14/:23/:31 (8.5 s apart), -37 and -42 on the gravebug and Logan (n=2); no Vanish seen (it died 22 s into the fight). Shade wolf Vanish: two wolves in their fights left the view at 1 tile (0x1D) 4 times, 4.3-15 s into the fight and 19-22 s apart, for 3.5-5.8 s, and came back on the gravebug each time with a hit (21-28) before any re-guard. Countess transfix (2 fights, 20261012_210013 and 20261013_173449): '*attempts to transfix*' every 5.2-5.5 s while fighting; with no copy of hers up 4 of 8 made a hostile copy of a pet ('*transfixed*', the pet's name and body, on its tile), with one up 0 of 4; the copy lasted 9.9-11.0 s to its 0x1D (n=4), in war mode 0-2.5 s after it appeared, and the pet itself made no step and no attack animation until then; the copies' 10 attributed hits on the first trip: 4 on Logan (28-37), 6 on the pets; the second walked 6 tiles to the phoenix rather than Logan at 8: a copy picks any of us but its original within 3 tiles, else any [INFERENCE: copy hits 2000, one took 1436 in 6 s and lived]. Corpsebride wail: '*wails*' every 7.5-7.8 s while it fights (25 in 4 fights), with a -13..-25 at once on the pets beside it (about 18 of 24 pet-tile-1 chances) and on Logan 2 of 11 times at 2-3 tiles [INFERENCE: an area hit on each of us, near_chance within radius 1, far_chance at 2-3]. Vampire drain and disease as poison 15 % (#2639) [INFERENCE].
